annotation.summary_en: Provisional English outline of Japan's MIC/METI AI Guidelines for Business v1.1 (April 2025). The voluntary, risk-based living document sets ten common guiding principles and assigns specific duties to AI developers, providers and business users. It also builds on the Hiroshima Process Code of Conduct for advanced AI systems.
key_provisions_or_claims: Ten Common Guiding Principles: human-centric, safety, fairness, privacy, security, transparency, accountability, education/literacy, fair competition, innovation
Distinguishes the obligations of AI developers, AI providers and AI business users
Voluntary risk-based approach, with measures proportionate to the level and probability of risk
Living document updated through multistakeholder review under agile governance
Includes the Hiroshima Process International Code of Conduct matters for advanced AI systems
